note: Closed set of properties the proto-tools catalogue can actually address. A property with no evaluator is expressed by assigning NO term, never by adding an unbacked one. Every term must resolve to at least one metric in registry/proto_catalog.json; tests/test_vocabulary.py enforces it.

terms.definition: Model confidence that a predicted monomer fold is correct.
Model confidence in a predicted inter-chain interface.
Predicted positional error in a structure prediction.
How probable a sequence is under a protein or nucleotide language model.
Whether a predicted structure is physically self-consistent.
Estimated energetic favourability of a designed interface.
Size and shape of a designed interface.
Hydrophobic character of a surface or interface.
A tool's own aggregate ranking of the designs it produced.
